verdict.rationale: BILL's own marketing describes AI-powered spend management that automatically categorizes transactions, and an AI Invoice Coding Agent that codes bills. These are AI outputs derived from the user's data inside the product, but they are automated categorization and coding rather than surfaced insights or recommendations. The evidence is also only thin marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analytics on spend data, explicit suggestion or recommendation features, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: smart, flexible cards paired with AI-powered spend management —so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant
